The most basic taco made with boiled seasoned pork shoulder. There is a lot of meat, and it has a light and soft taste.

Spicy sausage tacos. Compared to other places, it has less of a spicy pepper flavor and is closer to a subtle spicy flavor. Does it feel a little more suited to Korean tastes?

-Doraechang
Mesentery area of pigs. Although it has many roles, it is an extremely oily area because it stores fat and passes through blood vessels, lymph vessels, and nerves to the intestines. These tacos are also soft and rich in oil, so they are savory. It will be easier to understand the difference if you compare it to carnitas.
--------
In fact, it felt a bit ordinary compared to its reputation. This place seems to use wheat tortillas rather than corn, but the tortillas smelled quite a bit like flour, and the meat overall had a dry feel due to the lack of moisture. Definitely lower than Villa Guerrero. So I'm not sure if it's worth waiting in line to eat. Still, it's a mainland Mexican style taco restaurant that's different from the Tex-Mex style like God Eat, so it wouldn't be a bad idea to visit at least once if you're curious.

This is a space that combines food taste, atmosphere, and convenience. What impressed me the most when I first visited was the stunning open view. As I ate while looking at the scenery unfolding outside the window, the taste of the food felt even more special. During the day, it is filled with natural light, creating a bright and cheerful atmosphere, and in the evening, it becomes a more elegant space with emotional lighting.

The food was also better than expected. It feels like it was carefully cooked with fresh ingredients, and the plating is sophisticated, adding to the enjoyment of looking at it. No matter which menu I chose, I was satisfied with the balanced and deep flavor.

And convenient parking is a big plus! It's easy to feel stressed about parking in crowded places, but this place has plenty of parking space, so you can visit without burden even if you bring your car. Thanks to this, I was able to enjoy my meal more comfortably.

If you want to enjoy a leisurely meal with a great view, Rirr is the best choice. It's a place I definitely want to visit again because it has everything from atmosphere to taste to convenience. It's the perfect place not only for special occasions, but also to stop by and enjoy a pleasant meal!

If it were close to my house, I would really want to come here often, but it's far away so I can't come often, but if I want to eat egg tarts, it's worth the trouble of coming all the way.
